name: spec-row-caption
what: three-column tiny caption row stating a type spec ("Body / 15px / 150%") like a redline note
build: 10px uppercase-free mono/grotesk, evenly split into label / value / value across a fixed width, thin rule above
use: annotating type or spacing decisions inline in a case-study page

name: radial-loading-glow
what: pulsing circular loading mark built from concentric dotted rings and a glowing crescent centre, over a hazy period-cityscape background
build: label "LOADING" tracked wide above the mark; mark ~120px, soft golden bloom, dotted orbit rings at two radii with small node dots; background photograph desaturated and darkened to near-silhouette
use: loading screen, transition state

name: date-credit-footer-bar
what: full-width black footer bar with a bold date block, section label, and right-aligned credit
build: black bar ~48px tall, left cluster = bold year + stacked day/month in mono, centre = section name, right = small glyph mark + author name
use: case-study slide footers, portfolio artboard chrome

name: orbit-ring-halo
what: two thin elliptical rings crossing at an angle around a central diagram node, one ring tinted red as an accent, with small dot satellites riding the rings
build: ellipses drawn at differing rotations, 1px stroke, one ring recoloured red while the other stays neutral grey, 2–3 small filled dots placed along the rings
use: highlighting a "live/active" core node inside a technical diagram

name: vertical-gradient-bar-with-rotated-label
what: a tall rounded rectangle filled with a two-stop gradient, its name set in a vertical (rotated 90°) caption running through the middle, hex codes at top and bottom corners
build: 3 bars side by side sharing one card, each ~140x300px, 16px radius, "Colour Gradient" label rotated bottom-to-top centred, hex chips top-left/bottom-left in small pill tags
use: gradient-family palette sheets, brand colour-ramp documentation

name: rounded-outer-frame-chrome
what: the entire composition sits inside one large rounded-corner frame like a physical card or device bezel, with a hamburger icon top-right and a scroll-handle glyph bottom-right
build: ~28px outer radius, 1px hairline border, small utility icons inset 24px from each corner
use: presenting a website design as a bounded artifact/device rather than edge-to-edge

name: neumorphic-inset-tile
what: the pressed/concave counterpart of the raised tile — same shape but reads as carved into the surface rather than raised from it
build: identical geometry to the raised tile but with shadow direction reversed (inner shadow top-left light, inner shadow bottom-right dark)
use: pressed/active button states in neumorphic UI

name: circular-seal-badge
what: a small circular stamp-like badge with a short code/name set in a ring, placed in a corner as a certification/edition mark
build: ~50px circle, thin outer ring, bold short text centred, positioned bottom-right corner
use: edition/publisher marks on posters, key art or covers

name: icon-radio-option-row
what: a list of selectable rows each with a radio dot, a label, and a trailing small icon illustrating the option, one row shown selected with a glowing accent ring
build: rows ~48px, radio circle left, label centre, small line icon right, selected row gets a full accent-colour border + inner glow, unselected rows plain dark
use: quiz/preference selection UI, settings choices with visual hints

name: underline-only-form-fields
what: login form fields with no visible box — just a small caption label above a plain baseline rule
build: 10px caption label, ~1px underline rule beneath the implied input area, generous vertical spacing between fields, plain text-only submit label at the end
use: minimal/luxury forms that avoid boxed input chrome

name: blurred-seam-footer-transition
what: the hero's colourful glow bleeds downward through the seam into an otherwise plain dark footer, softly colouring the nearest footer content without a hard cut
build: gaussian-blurred colour glow sampled from the hero art, fading to zero a short distance into the footer's dark background
use: connecting a colourful hero to a plain footer without an abrupt boundary

name: split-hero-product-with-thumbnail-column
what: a hero split into a left navigation/copy zone and a right zone showing a large product photo flanked by a vertical stack of alternate-variant thumbnails
build: hero divided by a soft vertical seam (not a hard line — a blurred gradient edge), 3 thumbnail chips ~90px stacked with gaps at the far right, main product image centred and large
use: e-commerce/product hero sections offering variant switching without leaving the hero

name: promo-card-with-dual-cta
what: a small marketing card combining a moody product photo, a script headline overlay, and two stacked or paired CTA buttons beneath it, used to demo the palette "in situ"
build: photo fills ~70% of the card height, script headline + one pill button overlaid on the photo, two more buttons of different roles sit in a row below the photo
use: showing how a palette performs on a real promotional card, not just as swatches

name: palette-mosaic-collage
what: many differently-sized palette cards and one moody photograph tiled edge-to-edge with no gutters, forming a single reference sheet
build: irregular grid, photo tile sized to roughly 2 palette-cards, all tiles cropped flush, no rounding at the outer collage edge
use: mood-board sheets combining photography with derived palettes

name: vertical-totem-diagram
what: a symmetric stack of hexagonal/diamond modules connected top-to-bottom by a single spine, forming a layered systems diagram read top-down
build: 5 tiers, each a flattened hex or diamond shape narrowing toward joints, bracket lines to the right group tiers into labelled ranges (Organizations / Infrastructure / Systems & Models)
use: architecture/system diagrams, product-stack explainers

name: giant-numeral-progress-readout
what: a percentage rendered as an oversized geometric numeral treated as the hero graphic of a card, paired with a thin progress rule and a small diagonal arrow glyph
build: numeral ~64px in a squared-off geometric face with small superscript "%", thin 1px progress line above with a tiny percent + "LOADING" caption, arrow glyph bottom-right echoing the angle
use: loading/status screens wanting the number itself to be the dominant visual

name: crosshair-target-mark
what: a small precise crosshair/reticle icon used as a technical accent near a label
build: circle with four short tick marks at cardinal points, ~16px, thin stroke
use: military/technical marker beside coordinates or targeting copy

name: oversized-wordmark-single-accent-letter
what: a huge, thin tracked wordmark in low-contrast grey with exactly one letter recoloured in a loud accent (neon green), functioning as a logo mnemonic
build: letters ~140px light-weight geometric sans, base colour near-black-on-black (~15% opacity white), the accent letter full-opacity neon green
use: brand identity reveals, case-study title slides

name: crosshair-registration-grid
what: a repeating grid of thin white crosses at intersections plus fainter dashed diagonals, on black
build: solid grid lines forming a 3x3ish module, bold plus-mark exactly at each intersection, 45° dashed diagonals connecting crosses corner-to-corner, subtle centred watermark text
use: print-registration or blueprint-style overlay texture; technical/precision mood backgrounds

name: motion-streak-photo
what: a photographic reference showing directional light-streak abstraction (dark blue smears crossed by a hot orange diagonal), used as a colour-story source image
build: long-exposure-style streaks, cool dominant hue interrupted by one warm diagonal accent
use: sourcing a duotone or accent-on-dark palette from a single evocative image

name: dot-matrix-dissolve
what: the subject rendered as a sparse cluster of small glowing square dots tracing only its brightest contours, fading to nothing at the edges, as if scanned or pixel-dissolving
build: dot size ~2–4px on an implied grid, density highest where the source subject was brightest, warm-white glow colour against the dark half of the frame
use: "digitising/scanning" transitions, data-ification of an organic subject

name: playful-status-caption
what: casual, first-person status line under a hero cluster, in the local language, ending with an emoticon rather than an emoji
build: 14px regular, centred, sits between the hero carousel and the transport bar
use: friendly microcopy under a features/recommendation module

name: halftone-diamond-assembly
what: a diamond/rhombus burst built from a halftone dot field, dot size grading from large at the center to pinpoints at the tips — implies the shape is assembling or dissolving
build: radial dot-size gradient along both diagonals, pure black/white, symmetric on both axes
use: loading/transition animations, logo reveal/dissolve effects, halftone brand marks

name: xyz-axis-diagram
what: tiny 3-line axis indicator (X/Y/Z) placed near the caption block
build: three thin lines radiating from one origin point at different angles, single-letter labels at each tip, monospace-ish caption font
use: signalling "this is a 3D/technical diagram" without a full grid

name: gilded-list-row-locked
what: horizontal quest/level row with left icon medallion, gold-foil texture, right-aligned label, alternating locked/unlocked states
build: row height ~64px, rounded ends; unlocked rows carry a scratched gold-foil texture fill, locked row desaturated to bronze/grey with a small padlock icon; circular icon badge overlaps the row's left edge
use: level-select list, reward list, quest log

name: fanned-cover-carousel
what: a row of album/cover art cards fanned out with slight rotation and depth scaling, the centre card upright, largest and frontmost
build: 5 visible cards, outer cards rotated ~±12°/±6° and scaled down ~80%/90%, all with soft drop shadow and rounded corners, edge cards partly cropped by the frame
use: "featured" media carousels, music/podcast pickers, story selectors

name: spiky-outline-orbit-badge
what: a jagged star/cog-outlined badge shape with a thin ellipse "orbit" ring crossing through it at an angle, small x-marks at the ellipse's poles, bold word centred inside
build: 16-point jagged outline ~180px, 1px ellipse ring rotated ~20° through the centre, "x" glyphs at the ring's two extremes, bold centred word ~20px
use: "free/unlocked/orbit" concept badges for music or lifestyle brand key art

name: star-row-divider
what: a horizontal row of small identical sparkle/star glyphs used as a rule instead of a line
build: 6 four-point stars ~14px, even spacing, left-aligned above a text block
use: replacing a plain hairline divider with a branded decorative rule

name: bracket-range-label
what: a square bracket drawn beside a group of diagram tiers with a small vertical tracked-caps label naming the grouped range
build: bracket as a thin stroked path, label rotated -90°, 9px tracked caps, positioned at the bracket's midpoint
use: annotating tiers/ranges/phases in vertical diagrams

name: named-tonal-strip-card
what: a stacked set of horizontal rounded bars in one tonal family with the family name set in tracked caps across the middle bar and a hex code pinned to the far right of others
build: 3 stacked bars ~64px tall with 8px gaps, full rounded ends, name bar centred bold tracked caps, other bars right-aligned hex text
use: naming a colour story ("Crimson Velvet", "Navy Mirage", "Ocean Sunset") inside a moodboard

name: cross-over-plus-glyph
what: a bold four-armed X shape with a smaller solid plus shape emerging from behind its top point, both flat black with no outline
build: X arms ~90° diamonds meeting at a shared centre, plus sized ~35% of the X, offset upward and behind in z-order
use: a poster's single graphic subject when the brief wants one strong abstract mark, not a photo

name: anime-botanical-visual-novel-landing
what: illustrated visual-novel style landing page: framed character illustration with layered kanji/English title, leaf ornaments in the corners, sidebar nav and pill section tab
build: warm parchment ground (#e9e4d8), illustration in a soft-rounded frame with drop shadow, oversized translucent kanji watermark behind the frame, small pill tab top-left ("Home")
use: game/visual-novel landing pages, narrative-driven sites

name: arch-frame-moodboard-set
what: set of four differently-shaped cards (arch, dome, blob, rect) forming a moodboard grid, each combining photography, small icon accents and short text
build: mixed silhouette cards on a black canvas, consistent corner-tick and dot micro-icon language across all cards despite differing shapes
use: brand/mood presentation decks, Instagram carousel sets

name: rpg-chapter-select-screen
what: dark ornate chapter-selection UI with concentric circle motif, giant kanji watermark, and horizontal timeline of numbered chapters
build: near-black ground with fine gold hairline circles overlapping a central node; large translucent kanji glyph as background texture; "Chapter N" set in a tall serif with oversized drop cap; small gold dotted connector line running full width linking icon nodes
use: game menu, chaptered long-form narrative site, in-app "journey map"

name: vertical-hairline-diptych
what: the same subject shown twice side by side, split by a single thin vertical line, left half literal photography and right half an abstracted rendering of it
build: 50/50 split, 1px light hairline seam, both halves share identical background and framing so only the subject's treatment differs
use: before/after or real-vs-digital conceptual comparisons

name: labelled-icon-grid
what: a clean 4-column x 2-row grid of icons each with a centred caption label beneath, generous even spacing, no card backgrounds or dividers
build: icons ~70px each, caption 11px centred directly below with fixed gap, grid gutters equal horizontally and vertically
use: presenting an icon system or category list cleanly on dark backgrounds

name: hexagon-track-slider-illustration
what: a decorative "slider" illustration where the track is a hexagon shape and the handle is a pill, used purely as an icon/illustration rather than a functioning control
build: hexagon outline behind, horizontal pill capsule with a smaller pill handle overlapping its left third, all in matching greys
use: illustrating a "scheduling/settings" feature abstractly without a literal calendar

name: organic-ring-monogram
what: a hand-irregular ring/donut shape used as an abstract logomark, its outline slightly uneven like a brushstroke rather than a perfect circle
build: closed ring ~60px, outer/inner edge both slightly wavy, single flat white fill, no gradient
use: soft, organic wordmark companions for wellness/beauty brands

name: rotated-spine-label
what: a bold tracked-caps label running vertically up a narrow spine panel
build: text rotated -90°, centred on the spine width, small secondary label at the base in a different weight
use: book/box spine typography, also useful for vertical tab labels in UI

name: grainy-bokeh-film-photo
what: a soft-focus, visibly grainy photograph with a shallow depth of field turning the background into warm/cool blurred colour blobs
build: heavy analogue grain overlay, desaturated green-brown palette, out-of-focus circular highlights
use: nostalgic/organic mood photography as a base layer under type or effects
